status: declared by the pull request that closes #375 before any score was computed; the bar is Eleonora's ruling of 7 October 2026 on #374; the choices that ruling leaves open (the horizons the pass needs, the baseline rows' cut-offs, the bootstrap block length, the usefulness preference) are listed in that pull request for her review

published_v1.calibration: conformal PID with nested selection, then Platt out of fold (pressure.RECALIBRATION)

recal_isotonic.calibration: pressure model v1's raw distributional gbm (conformal PID with nested selection), recalibrated out of fold per threshold and horizon by the CORP isotonic fit (probability_calibration, 'isotonic')

recal_platt.calibration: the same raw forecast, Platt out of fold per threshold and horizon (probability_calibration, 'platt'): the published recalibration, rerun as the track's pooled control

recal_platt_group.calibration: the same raw forecast, Platt out of fold fitted per group (scarcity-state band x scheduled/ordinary day type, read as of the decision instant), pooled Platt when the group holds fewer than 60 earlier pairs or 3 events (group_calibration, 'group')

recal_platt_weighted.calibration: the same raw forecast, one Platt curve out of fold with the target group's earlier pairs weighted 1 and all others 0.25 (group_calibration, 'weighted'; regime-weighted calibration after Barber et al.)
